review_notes: Convert mappings nested in lists/tuples while preserving arbitrary scalar leaves. Mappings stay plain dictionaries, recursive calls use the whole container and scalar leaves become None. Construct the Dict class for mappings, recurse on each element and retain ordinary leaves. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'addict/addict.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('addict.addict')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from addict import Dict
marker=object()
value={'leaf':1,'seq':[{'x':2},marker],'pair':({'y':3},)}
converted=Dict._hook(value)
print('hook_root_type',type(converted).__name__)
assert isinstance(converted,Dict) and converted.leaf==1
assert isinstance(converted.seq,list) and isinstance(converted.seq[0],Dict)
assert converted.seq[0].x==2 and converted.seq[1] is marker
assert isinstance(converted.pair,tuple) and converted.pair[0].y==3
print('nested_conversion_and_leaf_identity',True)
PYREPLAY
